items.context: 紐約州對預測市場平台 Kalshi 提告，指控其提供的合約其實是「非法賭博」。這是美國多州對 Kalshi 及同業提告聲浪中的一起，背後牽涉誰有權監管這類平台——各州立場和川普政府並不一致。
items.thread_text:

items.headline: 休達邊境闖入潮18人溺斃
items.context: 西班牙屬地休達邊境週四夜間出現大規模闖關潮，數千名移民從摩洛哥湧入，至少18人在過程中溺斃。西班牙總理桑傑士稱這是「侵犯領土完整」，已派兵支援。
items.thread_text:
休達邊境闖入潮18人溺斃

西班牙屬地休達（Ceuta）與摩洛哥交界的邊境，週四夜間出現大規模闖關潮，數千人湧入，至少18人在混亂中溺斃。西班牙已經派兵前往支援，總理桑傑士（Pedro Sánchez）稱這是一次「侵犯領土完整」的事件。

—— 本則整理自 NPR、BBC 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 7 月 31 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
休達邊境闖入潮18人溺斃

西班牙屬地休達（Ceuta）與摩洛哥交界的邊境，週四夜間出現大規模闖關潮，數千人試圖游泳或翻越邊界湧入，至少18人在混亂中溺斃。

西班牙已經派兵前往支援。總理桑傑士（Pedro Sánchez）稱這波移民潮是「侵犯領土完整」，並將矛頭指向人口販運集團。

本則整理自 NPR、BBC 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 7 月 31 日發佈的報導。

items.context: 川普宣布，他主導的「和平委員會」已與哈瑪斯談成協議，讓哈瑪斯全面解除武裝，稱是「歷史性突破」。哈瑪斯一名資深官員則回應，以色列得先從加薩撤軍，協議才算數。

川普宣布，他主導的「和平委員會」已經和哈瑪斯談成協議，讓哈瑪斯全面解除武裝，稱這是「歷史性的突破」。哈瑪斯一名資深官員隨即回應——以色列得先從加薩撤軍，這份協議才算數。

川普宣布，他主導的「和平委員會」已經和哈瑪斯談成協議，讓哈瑪斯全面解除武裝，稱這是「歷史性的突破」。

不過哈瑪斯一名資深官員很快回應：以色列得先從加薩撤軍，這份協議才算數。雙方對協議的理解顯然還有落差，後續能不能真正落地，還是未知數。

items.thread_text:
最後一次家庭遊戲之夜

英國作家 Dominik Diamond 寫下一篇長文，回顧一家五口相處20年的最後一次電玩遊戲之夜——這個家庭經歷過重病、衝突與磨難，是電動遊戲一次次把大家拉回同一張沙發。另外，瑪麗蓮夢露（Marilyn Monroe）百歲冥誕前夕，有人發現她和影星達科塔強森（Dakota Johnson）竟是遠房表親，兩人的扮相對照照片也在網路上流傳。

items.voice_text: 一家五口，一起玩了20年遊戲，這是他們最後一次遊戲之夜。這個家庭經歷過重病、衝突，磨難不少，但作者說，每次吵得不可開交，電動遊戲總能把大家重新拉回同一張沙發。換個輕鬆的話題——瑪麗蓮夢露快滿一百歲了。有人發現，她和影星達科塔強森竟然是遠房表親，兩人的扮相放在一起，還真有點像。

sources.summary: I wanted our last family games night to be the best fun we’ve ever had. Maybe we should have stuck with Mario Kart … It is the end of an era for the Diamond family. For 20 years, there have been five of us living together. It has not been easy. Militant vegan daughters, sons who have inherited Scottish tempers, and a youngest child who attracts trouble like an industrial magnet, have meant our house has been conflict-laden at times. Throw in the fact that we are beset with all manner of mental health bobbins and chronic illnesses that resulted in two of our three kids almost dying in hospitals and you get a family that is combustible – but extremely close. Through it all, we had games. They always brought us back together. Not just us all hunkering over Super Mario Kart like some kind of UN-mandated family therapy, but the conversations that happen when any of us spy another playing something new. Games are a cultural touchstone that helped us crack through the veneer of disagreements and distrust and remind us that we have more things in common than we sometimes feel. Continue reading...

sources.summary: The vogue for celebrity ancestors can be traced back to Robert Pattinson descending from Dracula and Benedict Cumberbatch being related to just about everyone To mark Marilyn Monroe’s 100th birthday, a short film will premiere at this year’s Venice film festival. Entitled Flesh Impact, the film has been written and directed by Maggie Gyllenhaal, and will star two versions of Monroe. The first, played by Ellen Burstyn, will apparently be “a version of Monroe the world never got to see”, while Dakota Johnson will play Monroe in her pomp. Ahead of its premiere, a photo of Johnson dolled up as Monroe has been released. And it has to be said that the resemblance is actually pretty good. This could be down to one of two reasons. The first is that Monroe is so iconic that you could slap a wig and a beauty spot on Phil Mitchell and you’d immediately see who he was trying to emulate. Or it could be because Marilyn Monroe and Dakota Johnson are literally related. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This bold family saga explores a search for healing and truth in the aftermath of the Rwanda genocide How to forgive the unforgivable? How to live in the aftermath of atrocity? Following 2016’s Small Country , French-Rwandan rapper and writer Gaël Faye takes on huge questions in his second novel, Jacaranda, which explores the seismic events of the Rwanda genocide and the aftershocks that continue to ripple through the generations. Structurally bold, the story opens in summer 1994 with Milan, Faye’s then 12-year-old protagonist, enjoying an extended break from school. Milan’s father is white French and the family’s life in Versailles is the embodiment of first world ease – their holiday that year, as usual, spent sailing at the Île de Ré. Milan’s mother, though, is Rwandan. Venancia arrived in the 1970s, establishing a life for herself, a successful clothing boutique, a family. However, she cannot share the French ease, much less her thoughts on the disturbing reports from Rwanda now making the evening news. Continue reading...
sources.title: Jacaranda by Gaël Faye review – the limits of forgiveness after Rwanda

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Republic) Casting herself as a flower trampled underfoot, the superstar’s eighth album swaps the ​glitz of her Wicked years ​f​or dark blooms of haunted electronics ‘Tell me who’s to blame?” Ariana Grande asks, exasperated, on the title track of her eighth album, Petal. “Is it the people or myself?” As bleary, fuzzed-up drums threaten to drown her out, this shadowy carousel-ride of a song cycles through more questions than answers. Does her success only make her need more of it? Can her new record of No 1 singles stave off heartbreak? Does Grande’s life shape her music, or does her music shape her life? Moody and muted, Petal is a riposte to the glitz and sparkle of the pop star’s Oscar-nominated turn in Wicked and the theatre kid energy of her last album, 2024’s Eternal Sunshine . She describes this record as one of “unfiltered rage”, and there’s plenty Grande could be angry about: just this week she filed a lawsuit against hackers who allegedly stole and sold numerous unreleased songs. Continue reading...
